replies.author: @MariusClausen-bf2kw
replies.text: In the middle, where it is most remote. I have already been to Borneo, both Brunei and Kota Kinabalu. Kota Kinabalu is on the top of my "want to returne" place, with East Timor as number 2 and Papua New Guinea as number 3. This winter i visited Easter Island, La Paz, Fiji and they are not on the list. i have visited 22 countries inn Asia, and 61 contris around the world, so for KK to rank as number 1 says that is a place worth visiting.

comments.author: @UnrealWorldJourney1
comments.text: What makes Borneo so extraordinary is that life there is still shaped by one of the oldest rainforest ecosystems on Earth. 🌿 From Indigenous communities and river settlements to caves, orangutans and remote jungle interiors, the island feels like a place where human life and wilderness are still deeply intertwined. It’s fascinating to see how traditions survive in an environment that modern development is rapidly changing.
